newsitem.title: UK: Cobalt traders await DLA tender news.
newsitem.headline: Cobalt traders await DLA tender news.

text.p: The result of a tender by the U.S. Defense Logistic Agency (DLA) on Monday to sell cobalt rondelles and granules was keenly awaited for any impact it may have on market prices, traders said.
The DLA will open bids, which must be valid for three working days, in Washington at 1800 GMT.
Traders said the tender is divided into four categories and that bids will be evaluated separately for each category based on the amount of cobalt contained.
Available for sale will be 558,515 lbs of 99.0-99.29 percent grade, 362,036 lbs of 99.30-99.39 percent, 458,490 lbs of 99.40-99.49 percent and 190,248 lbs of 99.50-99.59 percent.
Traders pointed out that the cobalt is being offered without quality or weight guarantee and a requirement for payment before release.
These factors plus the grade and shape of material being offered will likely see the cobalt being sold at discount rates, traders said.
At past tenders DLA cobalt has often gone at a discount to Russian 99.3 percnet cobalt which is currently quoted around $21.00 a lb.
